methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected directly from each provider's pricing page on the accessed date of 2026-06-13, except where the vendor page blocked automated access (Intuit/QuickBooks and Xero both returned HTTP 503/timeout to automated fetch), in which case figures were taken from clearly-cited corroborating sources that quote the published list rates. Prices are recorded as the regular published monthly USD rate (not introductory/promotional discounts); per-seat or per-additional-user pricing is noted in billingModel and notes. Quote-only / 'Let's Talk' / 'contact sales' tiers carry a null monthlyUsd, and call-center metrics (minutes, calls, overage) are null because they do not apply to accounting software.

vendors.name: QuickBooks Online
vendors.provenance: QuickBooks Online published list pricing (quickbooks.intuit.com/pricing). Official page blocked automated fetch (timeout); regular monthly list rates verified via NerdWallet QuickBooks pricing guide (updated 2026-03-06), which documents Intuit's published rates effective July 2025.

plans.name: Solopreneur Lite
plans.notes: Single-user product for one-person/sole-proprietor businesses; income and expense tracking, basic invoicing, estimated taxes. Free $0 entry tier also offered.

plans.name: Simple Start
plans.notes: 1 user. Income/expense tracking, invoicing and payments, general reports, receipt capture, mileage and cash flow tracking.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Up to 3 users. Adds bill management, time tracking, and multi-currency support.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Up to 5 users. Adds inventory tracking, project profitability, and class/location tracking.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Up to 25 users. Adds batch invoicing, custom user roles, workflow automation, dedicated account team, and enhanced reporting/analytics.

vendors.name: Xero
vendors.provenance: Xero US published pricing (xero.com/us/pricing-plans). Official page repeatedly returned HTTP 503 to automated fetch; regular monthly list rates verified via costbench Xero pricing page and corroborated across multiple 2026 pricing aggregators reporting the identical $25/$55/$90 US tiers, with the Early plan's 20-invoice/5-bill caps confirmed. Annual billing ($300/$660/$1,080) is exactly 12x the monthly rate, so no annual discount is recorded (the earlier '~10%' figure was unverifiable and removed). All Xero plans include unlimited users (flat per-organization pricing).

plans.name: Early
plans.notes: Unlimited users. Hard caps of 20 invoices/quotes and 5 bills per month; bank reconciliation, short-term cash flow snapshot. Annual billing ($300/yr) is exactly 12x the monthly rate — no annual discount.

plans.name: Growing
plans.notes: Unlimited users and unlimited invoices, quotes, bills, and bank transactions; bulk reconciliation. Annual billing ($660/yr) is exactly 12x the monthly rate — no annual discount.

plans.name: Established
plans.notes: Unlimited users; adds multi-currency, project tracking, expense claims, and advanced analytics/cash flow forecasting. Annual billing ($1,080/yr) is exactly 12x the monthly rate — no annual discount.

vendors.name: FreshBooks
vendors.provenance: FreshBooks published pricing collected directly from freshbooks.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Listed regular monthly rates recorded (page also showed a 90%-off introductory promo, excluded here). Team Members add $11/mo per additional user across plans.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Up to 5 billable clients. Unlimited invoices, expense tracking, online payments, basic reports. Additional team members $11/mo each.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Up to 50 billable clients (Most Popular). Adds double-entry accounting reports, recurring billing, client retainers. Additional team members $11/mo each.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Unlimited billable clients. Adds project profitability, customizable email templates, and advanced reporting. Additional team members $11/mo each.

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Custom 'Let's Talk' pricing. Unlimited clients, lower credit-card transaction fees, 2 included team-member accounts, dedicated phone support and account manager.

vendors.name: Wave
vendors.provenance: Wave published pricing collected directly from waveapps.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Regular monthly rate recorded (page also showed a $9.50 first-3-months promo on Pro, excluded here). Payment processing is 2.9% + $0.60 per card transaction.

plans.name: Starter (Free)
plans.notes: Free forever. Unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records; mobile invoicing; cash flow dashboard. Card payments 2.9% + $0.60 per transaction.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Adds auto-import and auto-categorization of bank transactions, unlimited receipt capture, automated late-payment reminders, and discounted card processing (first 10 transactions/month at 2.9% + $0).

plans.name: Wave Advisors
plans.notes: Starting at $199/mo. Includes Pro features plus a dedicated bookkeeper, monthly financial statements, and expert support.

vendors.name: Zoho Books
vendors.provenance: Zoho Books published pricing collected directly from zoho.com/us/books/pricing on 2026-06-13. Monthly-billing rates recorded; annual billing is lower (noted per plan). Additional users $3/mo each (monthly) or $2.50/mo (annual).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user + 1 accountant. Free while annual revenue stays under the $50K threshold. Invoicing, expense tracking, basic reports.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 3 users. $20/mo monthly billing, $15/mo billed annually (save $60/yr). Bank reconciliation, recurring transactions, reporting tags.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 5 users. $50/mo monthly billing, $40/mo billed annually (save $120/yr). Adds bills, sales/purchase orders, project tracking, multi-currency.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 10 users. $70/mo monthly billing, $60/mo billed annually. Adds custom domain, vendor portal, budgeting, custom workflow rules.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: 10 users. $150/mo monthly billing, $120/mo billed annually. Adds advanced inventory, warehouse management, advanced multi-currency.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: 15 users. $275/mo monthly billing, $240/mo billed annually. Adds advanced analytics (Zoho Analytics) and 25 custom modules.

vendors.name: Patriot Software Accounting
vendors.provenance: Patriot Software accounting published pricing collected directly from patriotsoftware.com/accounting/pricing on 2026-06-13. Regular monthly rates recorded (page also showed a 50%-off-for-6-months promo, excluded here).

plans.name: Accounting Basic
plans.notes: Unlimited customers/invoices and vendors/payments, automatic bank imports, income/expense tracking, accept card payments, financial reporting, account reconciliation.

plans.name: Accounting Premium
plans.notes: Everything in Basic plus estimates, user-based permissions, recurring invoices, payment reminders, receipt/document management, and subaccounts.

vendors.name: Bench
vendors.provenance: Bench published pricing collected directly from bench.co/pricing on 2026-06-13. Monthly rates recorded as the 'starting at' month-to-month figures; annual prepay (~20% lower) noted in provenance only where the page stated an explicit annual total.

plans.name: Bookkeeping Grow
plans.notes: Starting at $199/mo (or $1,910 billed annually). For businesses under $250K annual revenue. Dedicated bookkeeping team, monthly books, P&L/balance sheet, 1099 reporting, scheduled touchpoints.

plans.name: Bookkeeping Core
plans.notes: Starting at $399/mo (or $3,830 billed annually). Dedicated experts, monthly books, P&L/balance sheet, 1099 reporting, unlimited communication.

plans.name: Bookkeeping Core + Tax
plans.notes: Starting at $599/mo (or $5,750 billed annually). All Core features plus licensed tax professionals and annual business + individual income tax filing.

vendors.name: Bookkeeper360
vendors.provenance: Bookkeeper360 published pricing collected directly from bookkeeper360.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Monthly bookkeeping-service rates recorded; tax and CFO add-on services noted in notes but only the recurring bookkeeping plans are listed as core tiers.

plans.name: Monthly Bookkeeping
plans.notes: $399/mo. Monthly financial close for steady-growth businesses; dedicated bookkeeping. Optional add-ons: business tax $1,000/yr, fractional CFO $2,000/mo, onboarding $1,000.

plans.name: Weekly Bookkeeping
plans.notes: $599/mo (Most Popular). Weekly financial visibility for fast-moving businesses; dedicated bookkeeping with more frequent reconciliation and reporting.
